actionInventoryLimits: Named API callsites in non-test pages/components, including conditional/legacy/dev surfaces, are static evidence only.
Lexical read/mutation category is triage, not endpoint authorization proof.
Dialog, navigation and keyboard commands are recorded in 4-route-map.md. Runtime plugin page/action names need registry/API access.
Direct component-source mapping does not infer nested reachability. Empty routes means shared, nested, legacy or unrouted; never presume safe to drop.

provenance.method: Babel TypeScript/JSX AST parser; path-bearing and index Route nodes in App.tsx, with AGENT_FILTER_TABS expanded; named API callsites from non-test pages/components
excludeFromPageVisits: redirect-or-compatibility when separately measuring target page
provenance.verification: Static source only; no app/API/browser/DB execution

quickSearch: tasks by API q with includeRoutineExecutions
client fuzzy project names and descriptions
commands: Open file in issue when fileViewerEnabled
searchBaseline.limits: Do not claim skills/routines/cases are full-search result types today; operator/filter coverage must remain from parser.
